description: The pure-AST calendar templates of lib/calendar.esm (`year`, `month`, `day`, `hour`, `minute`, `second`, `day_of_year`, `julian_day`, `is_leap_year`), each applied to scenarios of tests/closed_functions/datetime/<fn>/expected.json and asserted at tolerance 0, so every binding's expanded template reproduces the pinned binary64 reference values there. The instant is a parameter in seconds; the templates use no `faq`.

scope_excluded.go: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). Go's expansion of the calendar templates is checked by its closed-function harness (pkg/esm/closed_functions_test.go). This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.
scope_excluded.typescript: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). TypeScript's expansion of the calendar templates is checked by its closed-function harness (src/closed-functions.test.ts). This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.

tolerances.detail: Every asserted value is the pinned binary64 reference value of tests/closed_functions, matched bit for bit.
